headline: Nazara to Acquire Controlling Stake in Social Gaming Platform Bluetile and BestPlay for USD 100.3 million
sum: Nazara Technologies announced acquisition of a controlling stake in social gaming platforms Bluetile and BestPlay for $100.3 million (₹918 cr), expanding its gaming portfolio in the casual and social gaming segment.
implication: Cross-border gaming M&A by an Indian gaming company requires coordination of foreign investment approvals (FIPB/DPIIT), Indian tax residency and CbCR compliance, and potential SEBI disclosure gating under Reg. 30 (LODR); the controlling-stake structure suggests earnout or deferred consideration mechanics typical in gaming roll-ups.
detail: Nazara Technologies, a listed Indian gaming and esports company (BSE: NAZARA; NSE: NAZARA), announced the acquisition of a controlling stake in Bluetile and BestPlay, both social gaming platforms. The all-cash transaction valued at USD 100.3 million (approximately INR 918 crores) positions Nazara to consolidate its presence in the casual and social gaming vertical, a segment complementary to its existing multiplayer, fantasy sports and esports operations. The acquisition expands Nazara's geographic footprint and diversifies its game titles and user demographics.
